questions.q_en: Find the sum of all the prime numbers between 70 and 85.
questions.solution_en:
Prime numbers between 70 and 85 = 71, 73, 79, 83

Required sum = 71 + 73 + 79 + 83 = 306

questions.q_en: In an exam, Reeta got 5% marks more than passing marks and Veena got 8% marks less than passing marks. Marks obtained by Reeta and Veena are 120 and 68 respectively. Find the passing marks of the exam.
questions.solution_en:
Let maximum marks = m

Passing marks = p

p + 5% of m = 120 -----(1)

p - 8% of m = 68 -------(2)

On solving eqn (1) and (2) -----

5% of m + 8% of m = 52

m = 52*100/13 = 400

p = 100

questions.q_en: A train running at the speed of 72 km/h crosses a 240 m long platform in 18 seconds. How long will it take to cross a bridge which is 720 m long?
questions.solution_en:
Let length of train = L

Speed = 72 x 5/18 = 20 m/s

Distance covered to cross platform = L+240

(L+240)/20 = 18

=> L + 240 = 360

=> L = 120m

Time taken to cross bridge = (720+120)/20 = 840/20 = 42 s

questions.q_en: In a 100-m race, A beats B by 20 m and B beats C by 5 m. In the same race, find the distance by which A beats C.
questions.solution_en:
Ratio of speeds of A and B = 100 : 80 = 5 : 4

Ratio of speeds of B and C = 100 : 95 = 20 : 19

Ratio of speeds of A and C = 5/4 * 20/19 = 25/19

When A runs 100 m, C runs (19/25) * 100 = 76 m

A beats C by = 100 - 76 = 24 m

questions.q_en: Find the length of chord MP if MQ is diameter of length 16 cm and ∠MNO = 45°.
questions.solution_en:
∠MPQ = 90° (MQ is the diameter and any triangle inscribed in a semicircle is always a right angle.)

∠PQO + ∠PNO = 180°(PNOQ is a cyclic quadrilateral.)

∠PQO = 180° - 45° = 135°

∠PQM = 180° - 135° = 45°

In △MPQ, ∠PMQ = 180° - 90° - 45° = 45°

So, MP = PQ (Let them be 'x')

MQ2 = MP2 + PQ2

162 = x2 + x2

2x2 = 256

x2 = 128

MP = x = 8√2 cm

2x3+ax2-bx-4=0

2(-3)3+a(-3)2-b(-3)-4=0

-54+9a+3b-4=0

9a+3b=58....(1)

Similarly putting x-1=0,x=1 is given expression

2x3+ax2-bx-4=0

2(1)3+a(1)2-b(1)-4=0

2+a-b-4=0

a-b=2....(2)

Solving equation 1 and 2 we get, a=16/3,b= 10/3

a:b=8:5

questions.q_en: Sale of almonds in a store in July and August is increased by 60% and 50% respectively as compared to that in previous month. If 105.6 kg almonds sold in August, then how much more almonds sold in July as compared to that in previous month?
questions.solution_en:
Sale of almonds in August = 105.6 kg

Sale of almonds in July = 105.6 * 100/(100 + 50) = 70.4 kg

Sale of almonds in June = 70.4 * 100/(100 + 60) = 44 kg

Therefore, difference = 70.4 - 44 = 26.4 kg

questions.q_en: Which of the following is a quadratic equation?
questions.solution_en:
a) (x - 5)(x + 3) = (x + 2)(x - 12)

x2 - 5x + 3x - 15 = x2 + 2x - 12x - 24

-2x - 15 = - 10x - 24

2x + 15 = 10x + 24

8x + 9 = 0(not quadratic equation)

b) (x + 5)2 = x2 + 7x - 6

x2 + 25 + 10x = x2 + 7x - 6

3x + 31 = 0(not quadratic equation)

c) x3 - 4x2 - x + 1 = (x - 2)3

x3 - 4x2 - x + 1 = x3 - 8 - 6x2 + 12x

2x2 - 13x + 9 = 0 (quadratic equation)

d) (x + 3)3 = 4x(x2 - 3)

x3 + 27 + 9x2 + 27x = 4x3 - 12x

3x3 - 9x2 - 39x - 27 = 0 (not quadratic equation)

questions.q_en: The length of two parallel sides of a trapezium are 25 metre and 30 metre. If its height is 20 metres, then what is the area of the trapezium?
questions.solution_en:
Area of trapezium = (1/2) * (a + b) * h

Where 'a' and 'b' is the length of parallel sides of the trapezium and 'h' is the perpendicular distance between those two parallel sides.

Area of given trapezium = (1/2) * (25 + 30) * 20

= 55 * 10

= 550 metre2
